notes.title: Join our New Community Discord!
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes – I hope this transmission finds you well.

Now that we’ve announced our new game for Steam and confirmed cross-platform play, we know (from experience) that there’s nothing better than a dedicated space to get hyped together!

We’re excited to present the official [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/6s3fWJskxe]Lucky Mountain Games Discord Server[/url][/b]!

We always wanted to create a fun, chill, and informative place for our community to gather under one roof. In all honesty, we found other social platforms to be quite limiting for that goal; we (as gamers [i]and[/i] indie developers) want to interact with players in real-time and share info directly with those who want to hear it.

[b]In our Discord server, you can:[/b]
[list]
[*] Have discussions about our games with the community 
[*] Share your thoughts and ideas with us
[*] Register interest in upcoming playtests/betas  
[*] Participate in giveaways, events, and competitions 
[*] Show off your art & creative work
[*] Stay up-to-date about our games and our studio (no spam, we promise!)
[/list]
Leap right into action through this permanent invite link:
https://discord.com/invite/6s3fWJskxe  

We can’t wait to see you there!  


P.S.: The first 10 members to join and introduce themselves will receive a special flair + chat colour to commemorate the launch of our Discord server.

notes.title: Heroes of Forever is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Back when we announced our game in September, we asked our community what platforms they’d like to see the game on. In response, we received an influx of requests from you fantastic folks. So, for those who have been eagerly (or patiently) waiting…

[b]We’re thrilled to announce that Heroes of Forever is now available to wishlist on Steam![/b] If you own a PC-compatible VR headset, you’ll be able to dive into fast-paced arcade action on launch.

Furthermore, we can confirm that you’ll be able to play online co-op with anyone you want – [b]Heroes of Forever will have full cross-platform support.[/b]

We hope that this news will get you hyped for our upcoming release and we’d love to hear your thoughts about it!

For the latest updates, release dates, and exclusive content, follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/luckymountaingames]social channels[/url]. We’ll also be announcing opportunities for playtesting via our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6s3fWJskxe]Discord community[/url], so stay tuned!
